dedupe_keys.name: madrid municipal buildings energy consumption and solar photovoltaic generation monthly

description: Dirección General de Sostenibilidad y Control Ambiental, Madrid City Council publishes monthly energy data of municipal buildings from the advanced energy monitoring service under the city energy services framework agreement (sensors are installed in the highest-consuming buildings, those with the most variable use, those in certification programmes and others where operations warrant), plus a linked dataset on the solar photovoltaic installations of municipal buildings and centres such as district board offices, libraries, cultural, sports, senior and social service centres. Coverage: the municipal buildings of the city of Madrid; both datasets are listed as monthly, modified 2026-09-17 (consumption) and 2026-09-28 (photovoltaic generation). Format and access: CSV, XLSX, PDF, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: sensors cover only some municipal buildings, the files were not opened so the energy carriers, columns, building count and history length are unconfirmed, and the record is anchored to the consumption page with the photovoltaic page linked. Simulation uses: building-level demand and on-site generation data for calibrating urban building-energy models, and for retrofit and photovoltaic scenario studies. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
